description: This file defines an EmbeddingManager class responsible for managing text embeddings using the OpenAI API. It includes methods for embedding individual texts and batches of texts asynchronously.

classes.name: EmbeddingManager
classes.description: A class to manage creation of OpenAI text embeddings asynchronously, with support for batching and error handling.

methods.name: __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the EmbeddingManager with configuration settings and creates an OpenAI client.

methods.name: List[float] embed_text(self, text: str)
methods.description: Creates an embedding for a single text input asynchronously.

methods.name: List[List[float]] batch_embed(self, texts: List[str])
methods.description: Creates embeddings for multiple texts in batches asynchronously.

ctags.pattern: /^    async def batch_embed(self, texts: List[str]) -> List[List[float]]:$/
